bibl.title: A purchase of captives, Egypt, 29 BC
bibl.seg: Todd M. Hickey & James G. Keenan, A Purchase of Captives, Egypt, 29 BC.
bibl.note: Provenance unknown, just before 15 April 29 BC. Mass purchase of children (six) and women (three at least), all sold as "Theban". - Pp. 205-206: Appendix: Reconstructed Latin Original.
